title: OpenPlanr Protocol v1.4 skill evaluation fixture
description: One immutable evaluation input, bound to exact bytes by content digest and to exact handling by media kind. The record carries no field able to hold fixture bytes, so raw content and credential material can never travel inside it.

fixtureId.description: The literal prefix `efx_` followed by the hexadecimal part of `fixtureDigest`. Any other value is a foreign identity.

fixtureDigest.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical form of this record with `fixtureId` and `fixtureDigest` removed, so media kind and content digest are both identity-bearing.

mediaKind.description: Closed handling class. A reader that does not support the declared kind refuses the fixture instead of guessing.

contentDigest.description: SHA-256 over the fixture bytes at `sourcePath`. A recomputed digest that differs invalidates every observation bound to this fixture.

retention.description: Fixture bytes stay on the machine that authored them. No other retention is representable.

containsCredentialMaterial.description: Explicit negative declaration. A fixture carrying credential material cannot be expressed by this contract.

relativePath.description: Normalized repository-relative path. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes, and dot segments are refused.
